VOICE COPILOT

Talk through your build.

Try “explain this step”, “show the whole build”, or “replay that step”. The copilot follows your loaded guide and can change steps, manual pages and views while you talk.

Starting sends microphone audio and the loaded guide’s instructions, parts, review notes and current step to OpenAI using paid API access. The voice feature does not send PDF files or filenames. Voice continues when this panel is collapsed.

Voice settings

Leave blank to use Unfold’s voice connection. An optional key is used for this session and cleared when you start.
